0x6000.text: Digital inputs, 8 per sub-index: bit n is input n of the block

0x6002.text: Polarity of the digital inputs, 8 per sub-index: a set bit inverts that input

0x6003.text: Filter constant of the digital inputs, 8 per sub-index: a set bit filters that input

0x6005.text: Global interrupt enable of the digital inputs: on means a change of an input sends its PDO

0x6006.text: Interrupt mask for any change of the digital inputs, 8 per sub-index

0x6200.text: Digital outputs, 8 per sub-index: bit n is output n of the block

0x6202.text: Polarity of the digital outputs, 8 per sub-index: a set bit inverts that output

0x6206.text: Error mode of the digital outputs, 8 per sub-index: a set bit makes that output take its error value on a device fault

0x6207.text: Error value of the digital outputs, 8 per sub-index: the value an output takes on a device fault when its error mode is on

0x6208.text: Filter mask of the digital outputs, 8 per sub-index: a cleared bit keeps that output from changing

0x6401.text: Analogue inputs, 16 bit, one per sub-index

0x6411.text: Analogue outputs, 16 bit, one per sub-index

0x6421.text: Interrupt trigger of the analogue inputs, one per sub-index: which conditions send the input's PDO

0x6421:1.text: Interrupt trigger of an analogue input

bits.3: decreased by more than negative delta
bits.4: increased by more than positive delta

0x6422.text: Interrupt source of the analogue inputs: which inputs caused the last interrupt

0x6423.text: Global interrupt enable of the analogue inputs: on means an input's trigger sends its PDO

0x6424.text: Interrupt upper limit of the analogue inputs, one per sub-index

0x6425.text: Interrupt lower limit of the analogue inputs, one per sub-index

0x6426.text: Interrupt delta of the analogue inputs, one per sub-index

0x6443.text: Error mode of the analogue outputs, one per sub-index: 1 makes the output take its error value on a device fault

0x6443:1.text: Error mode of an analogue output

0x6444.text: Error value of the analogue outputs, one per sub-index
